summary.text: Tresa Howell is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 52, which she has represented since December 2024, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A nurse by profession, she advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Tresa Howell was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Charleston in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse.

Ballotpedia lists her as affiliated with the Kanawha County Republican Executive Committee, the Kanawha Republican Women's Club, Moms for Liberty, the NRA and the West Virginia Citizens Defense League.
She was first elected to the House of Delegates in November 2024, defeating Democrat Thomas Jones, and took office on December 1, 2024.
